row.proto: uint64_t Career_Collect_RndEntriesForDepartment(void *owner, void *out_arr, uint64_t dept_key, uint64_t kind)
row.notes: Finds round param_3 in +0x2f8..+0x300 (id at +0, allowed dept bytes); if dept arg5 is allowed, for team param_4 ((+0xd60)+0x298 model) takes enabled upgrades (Career_Query_EnabledUpgrades) with +0x72 == dept; day = min(round start Career_Calc_CalendarEntryStartMinutes, now)>>5/45; keeps those with a kind-3 event on/before day-1, drops ones also having a kind-2 event at day-1; appends to out (+0xc00). (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_Collect_DeptUpgradesForRound (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V9695 Has a 5th mode argument and builds entries from the enabled-upgrade/calendar data (FUN_141244520, upgrade dev slots, day computation), not just a read of the dept list; dept list +0x2f8..0x300 stride 0x40 with int key matches.
